full_evidence: Narrow diff, required transitions, initialisation, hook/provider witnesses and correct evidence classes.
partial_evidence: Mostly correct implementation with bounded evidence gaps.
insufficient_evidence: P01 incomplete, forbidden edits or unsupported claims.

full_evidence: Concrete context, constraints, alternatives, capability gates, assumptions, decision, sensitivity and limits.
partial_evidence: ADR present but one evidence/gate/sensitivity element is weak.
insufficient_evidence: ADR missing or only a library preference.

full_evidence: One bounded genuine claim, independent check, justified verdict, correction and limitation.
partial_evidence: Claim and verdict present but independent evidence is weak.
insufficient_evidence: Model answer copied or treated as sole authority.

full_evidence: Stable locators, explicit pending work, privacy review and one readable PDF.
insufficient_evidence: Untraceable, private data exposed or incomplete submission.
